title: claim_continue_link_send's submitted/erased zero-row guards unpinned (round-2 guard lines)
evidence:
AND submitted_at IS NULL
  AND erased_at IS NULL
-- from the claim query; every integration call site exercises it only on a LIVE draft, e.g. draft_integration_test.gleam: `let _ = seed_draft_with_token(db, vacancy_id, "tok-seeded")` then `app_sql.claim_continue_link_send(db, uuid, "tenant@example.com", "tok-new")` — the four claim tests (mint/cooldown, clear-rearm, fan-out, 10-min window) never strip or tombstone the draft first.
detail: The claim matches by (vacancy, email), so only these two new round-2 lines stop a stripped or tombstoned row from winning a claim, re-minting a token, and sending real email. Guard semantics are pinned on the upsert and list queries but never on this one.
recommended_fix: Add two integration cases: claim after strip_draft_on_submit and claim after erase_draft_by_token (same email) both return zero rows.

title: form_draft.js loader inclusion unpinned on the pristine and error re-render pages
evidence:
view_draft_saver_script(),
-- inside view_application_page (form_view.gleam:109) and view_form_with_errors (form_pages.gleam:370). The pin precedent exists: form_view_test.gleam:321 asserts `html |> string.contains("/static/apply_analytics.js") |> should.be_true` on the pristine form, and form_pages_test.gleam:334 pins `form_draft.js` only on the RESUME render (`resume_page_has_resume_marker_banner_and_no_error_banner_test`). No test asserts form_draft.js on the pristine or form-errors renders.
detail: Deleting the script tag from the primary (or error) render silently kills the whole client-side save feature while every node-level wiring test stays green (they drive _initBrowser directly). The resume render has this pin; the other two script-carrying renders don't.
recommended_fix: Add one-line assertions that view_application_page and view_form_with_errors output contain "/static/form_draft.js", mirroring the apply_analytics.js pins.

title: Draft cap counts stripped/tombstoned rows toward the 500 — dead-row boundary unpinned
evidence:
OR (
    SELECT count(*) FROM application_draft d
    WHERE d.vacancy_id = $1::uuid
  ) < 500
-- no submitted_at/erased_at filter, while strip_draft_on_submit.sql states `-- The row itself stays (email + timestamps only)
-- until the retention sweep removes it at vacancy close.` The cap test (draft_cap_allows_existing_pairs_but_blocks_new_inserts_test) fills 500 LIVE rows via `FROM generate_series(1, 500) g` only.
detail: A vacancy accumulating 500 stripped+erased rows (rows persist until close) wedges all NEW draft saves even with few live drafts. Whether intended or not, this counting boundary has no pin either way.
recommended_fix: Either filter the count to live rows (submitted_at/erased_at IS NULL) or add a test pinning that dead rows count toward the cap, documenting the choice.
